question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Tighten one's belt

options.text: To make efforts to be slim

solution:
The correct answer is** 'To cut one's expenditure'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Tighten one's belt' **is **'To cut one's expenditure'. **
 
• **Tighten one's belt:** cut one's expenditure; live more frugally. (अपने खर्च में कटौती; अधिक मितव्ययिता से जीना)
 
 
• *Example: She said the poor must **tighten their belts.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To cut one's expenditure.*
